sources.title: 犹他州 10 个州政府部门 34 名开发者试点使用 Claude Code / Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.title_zh: 犹他州 10 个州政府部门 34 名开发者试点使用 Claude Code
sources.title_en: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.title_original: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.summary: Boris Cherny 介绍犹他州向 10 个州政府部门的 34 名开发者提供了 Claude Code。试点显示 80% 的开发者在 30 分钟内搭好可用环境，71% 的开发者在为期四周的试点结束前报告节省了 20 小时以上时间。该推文引用了 Anthropic 与 GSA 合作将 Claude 以 40% 折扣提供给联邦及各级政府的公告作为背景。
